honors.title: MakeUofT 2020 Winner - DetritusAI
honors.description:
• Built an object classification waste system using TensorFlow and Solace Event Broker
• Determined optimal garbage pickup route which is displayed using Google Maps API and React

honors.title: Hack the North Winner & Best use of Google Cloud - Guardian
honors.description:
•	Created a firefighter helmet that retrieves data such as temperature, carbon dioxide, and volatile compound levels from the environment using sensors and uploads to a Firebase real-time storage 
•	Designed the web user interface using Vue.js and ApexCharts to display information using dynamically updating charts, alerting first responders when critical levels are reached
honors.issuer: Issued by Hack the North 2019 · Sep 2019

volunteerExperiences.description:
Working with Social Diversity for Children Foundation to build a program registration platform using Next.js, PostgreSQL to simplify and streamline the parent/volunteer program registration process.

Led a team of 6 developers, 2 designers, and PM

Working with non-profits to build technical solutions for social good.

Built an adjudication platform using Next.js, React, and PostgreSQL to streamline the judging process for OOS Dancefest.
